task.title: Bound node status Cloud diagnostic latency

events.content: Cap the optional Cloud name lookup at two seconds: Cap the optional Cloud name lookup at two seconds

raw.question: Cap the optional Cloud name lookup at two seconds
raw.chosen: Cap the optional Cloud name lookup at two seconds
raw.reasoning: The macOS E2E showed the 10-second lookup budget could exceed node status's established 10-second command deadline after local broker readiness; two seconds keeps the diagnostic useful while preserving local status responsiveness.

retrospective.summary: Reduced Cloud registration diagnostic timeout to two seconds and pinned the budget in a unit test; live status completes in 2.31s.
